notes: Squeek Predict is a Sepolia prediction market MVP for the Squeekchain ecosystem / Buildooooor badge. Deploy SqueekPredict from src/SqueekPredict.sol; it has no constructor arguments, owner, admin, fees or initialization calls, and requires no deployment funding. It reads the fixed official SqueekCore V3 address 0x74665dAecA35A2303e767E76a2FF1FB6F93e119f. Anyone can create a YES/NO market on strictly more than a chosen number of completed Squeek blocks over a round-aligned 24-hour or 7-day window starting 1 hour to 7 days ahead. Betting closes when the window starts. Users stake Sepolia test ETH after deployment; the minimum bet is 0.0001 ETH and each side of a market is capped at 100 ETH (MAX_SIDE_POOL), so a full YES pool still accepts NO stakes and vice versa. Anyone can resolve after the window ends and Core certifies its endpoint, before the 30-day resolution grace (RESOLUTION_GRACE) expires; the grace is sized to outlast multi-day Reporter certification delays observed on Sepolia. Completed blocks are the difference between the whole-block heights at the two certified historical endpoints. Winners claim proportional payouts, with rounding dust paid to the final winner. Empty or one-sided markets can be cancelled after betting closes; unresolved markets can be cancelled only once the grace deadline passes, allowing bettors to claim refunds without Core access. README.md explains operation and data semantics. The included frontend accepts the confirmed deployment address for wallet interaction on Sepolia.
